sun_yat_sen.name: Dr. Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum
sun_yat_sen.price_text: Free · book a time slot online in advance
sun_yat_sen.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 08:30–17:00 · closed Monday (check on the day)
sun_yat_sen.tip: Climb the 392 steps early in the morning to beat the crowds and the heat.

confucius_temple.name: Confucius Temple, Nanjing
confucius_temple.price_text: ≈ CNY 30 for the temple hall · the surrounding streets are free
confucius_temple.hours: Temple roughly 09:00–21:00 · streets busy into the evening
confucius_temple.tip: Come after dark for the lit-up Qinhuai River, then eat at the snack stalls nearby.

massacre_memorial.name: Nanjing Massacre Memorial Hall
massacre_memorial.price_text: Free · reserve a ticket online with your passport
massacre_memorial.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 08:30–16:30 · closed Monday (check on the day)
massacre_memorial.tip: Book ahead and allow quiet time; the exhibits are heavy and very moving.

ming_xiaoling.name: Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum
ming_xiaoling.price_text: ≈ CNY 70 · often bundled with other Purple Mountain sites
ming_xiaoling.tip: Walk the Sacred Way of stone animals first, then the mausoleum itself.

happy_valley.name: Happy Valley Nanjing
happy_valley.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–260 day ticket · check current price online
happy_valley.hours: Roughly 09:30–21:00 in season · hours vary, check on the day
happy_valley.tip: Go on a weekday and arrive at opening for the big rides.

nanjing_university.name: Nanjing University (Gulou campus)
nanjing_university.price_text: Free · campus access may need registration, check on the day
nanjing_university.hours: Daytime · campus gates may restrict visitors
nanjing_university.tip: Walk the old Gulou campus and the leafy streets around it.

qinhuai_boat.name: Qinhuai River boat ride
qinhuai_boat.price_text: ≈ CNY 60–100 per person · check on the day
qinhuai_boat.tip: Take the night boat through the lantern-lit Fuzimiao stretch.

laomendong.name: Laomendong old street
laomendong.price_text: Free to walk · pay per snack
laomendong.tip: Try Nanjing snacks like duck blood vermicelli and salted duck here.

xuanwu_lake.name: Xuanwu Lake Park
xuanwu_lake.price_text: Free · small fee for some inner gardens
xuanwu_lake.tip: Walk or rent a bike along the lake with the city skyline behind you.

city_wall.name: Ming City Wall (Zhonghua Gate)
city_wall.tip: Walk the top of the wall for old-city views and photo spots.

presidential_palace.name: Presidential Palace of Nanjing
presidential_palace.tip: Modern Chinese history in a garden setting; allow two hours.

xinjiekou_walk.name: Xinjiekou shopping district walk
xinjiekou_walk.price_text: Free to walk · pay for shopping and food
xinjiekou_walk.tip: The city's central crossroads; good for malls, snacks and people-watching.

purple_mountain.name: Purple Mountain (Zijin Shan) trails
purple_mountain.tip: Link the mausoleum sites with a forest walk; wear comfortable shoes.

nanjing_museum.name: Nanjing Museum
nanjing_museum.tip: One of China's biggest museums; book a slot and go early.

south_station_food.name: Nanjing South Station food hall
south_station_food.price_text: Free to enter · pay per meal
south_station_food.tip: Handy for a quick meal before a train; try local duck noodles.

fuzimiao_night_walk.name: Fuzimiao night street walk
fuzimiao_night_walk.tip: Wander the lantern-lit lanes and riverbank after dinner.

jiqingsi.name: Jiming Temple
jiqingsi.tip: Small hillside temple near Xuanwu Lake; combine with a lake walk.

tangshan_hotspring.name: Tangshan hot springs
tangshan_hotspring.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–300 per person · check on the day
tangshan_hotspring.tip: A half-day soak east of the city; book a taxi or tour to get there.

nanjing_duck.name: Nanjing salted duck tasting
nanjing_duck.tip: The city's signature dish; buy from a busy local shop and eat it fresh.

zhonghua_gate_walk.name: Old south city wall walk
zhonghua_gate_walk.price_text: Free to walk outside the gate
zhonghua_gate_walk.tip: Walk the moat-side path for a quiet view of the old wall.
